Mixed purées

Apple and yogurt oat porridge

Joghurtos alma zabkása

6 months+ Replaced 20 min 2 portions

Serve the porridge warm with the yogurt stirred in. Do not put rhubarb in this bowl.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 20 g fine porridge oats (treat as gluten)
  • 180 ml water
  • 80 g cooked apple (peeled, cored, and cooked, with no sugar)
  • 80 g plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (milk allergen)

Allergens

milkgluten

Method

  1. Peel, core, and cook the apple until soft, then mash it smooth.
  2. Stir the oats into the water and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
  3. Cool the porridge until warm.
  4. Stir in the yogurt and the apple.
  5. Do not add sugar.

Replaced

The older version of this dish used rhubarb, which is harsh and high in oxalate. Rhubarb usually needs sugar, which does not belong in this bowl.

Drop the rhubarb, and stir plain yogurt into warm oat porridge and cooked apple instead. The bowl still contains milk and gluten from the yogurt and the oats.
